fato_historico: 1921: The Communist Party of Spain is founded, and issues the first edition of Mundo obrero.
energia_do_dia: The stars align to suggest that foundations matter today. Just as a new vision for collective unity took root long ago, you may find that building or organizing your personal life brings profound satisfaction. It is a good time to nurture your projects and consider how your dedication can bloom into something truly lasting and meaningful for your future.
frase_do_dia: Firm roots allow the tallest branches to touch the golden sky.
significado_numero: Represents the balance between material comfort and spiritual growth.
conselho: Trust your steady pace; slow progress is still powerful forward movement today.
